{"action":"done","summary":"All tests pass: 4 acceptance_public.py tests (R01-R08) and 223 upstream TinyDB tests. The existing tinydb/journal.py BatchWriter implementation correctly satisfies all requirements:

- R01: apply(operations) processes insert/remove operations with proper validation and ID return
- R02: Atomic batch with validation before commit and full rollback on error
- R03: Deep copy prevents aliasing; ordinary TinyDB APIs unaffected
- R04: Bool rejected as doc_id; structural validation of operations, documents, and types
- R05: preview() returns IDs without committing or consuming tokens
- R06: Fresh storage reads on each call, no stale snapshot
- R07: Idempotency tokens - repeated identical batches return cached result, different ops raise ValueError
- R08: Token bookkeeping isolated in BatchWriter instance"}
